summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: @ornikar/jest-config-react-native-web@12.0.9 declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases and then uses `execFileSync(bun, ['math_init.js'])` to execute a bundled 727 KB obfuscated JavaScript file shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled cjs bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with fully mangled identifiers, a large shuffled constant array, and a string-array rotator (`WV8StW`); the launcher `setup.mjs` itself uses hex-obfuscated identifiers (`_0xNNNN`) and a cover-story filename unrelated to a Jest preset. The package's declared `main` (`jest-preset.js`) contains only `throw new Error('Use @ornikar/jest-config-react-native/web instead');`, so the sole substantive behavior on `npm install` is running the opaque payload under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime that Node-based tooling cannot introspect. The advertised jest-preset purpose does not require Bun or an opaque native-runtime bundle, and the name closely resembles the legitimate `@ornikar/jest-config-react-native/web` subpath, consistent with a hijack or squat of the @ornikar scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
